_s26b_surface: s26b, queue item 5: 26.1.2's surface rule API on 26.2 (rt/CbS26SurfaceRules; javap of both)

_redirects_basis.net/minecraft/world/level/levelgen/Surfa: 26.1.2's BiomeConditionSource kept the keys and tested the biome at the position by key (Holder.is(Set.copyOf(keys)::contains)), encoded as a biome_is list of keys; 26.2's resolves the keys through a biome HolderGetter when built. The layer's condition is 26.1.2's, its codec registered as centurybridge:biome_is
_redirects_basis.net/minecraft/data/worldgen/SurfaceRuleD: 26.1.2: overworldLike(true, false, true); 26.2: overworld(getter) = overworldLike(getter, true, false, true). The layer builds 26.2's rules with its key getter, which SurfaceRules.isBiome turns into 26.1.2's key conditions (mixin/CbS26SurfaceRulesMixin); SurfaceRuleData uses the getter only through isBiome
26.2's body is 26.1.2's (isBiome given the getter, noiseCondition named noiseCondition2d) plus 26.2's sulfur cave rules; built as overworld()
26.2's nether(getter) uses the getter only through isBiome; built as overworld()

net/minecraft/world/level/levelgen/Surfa.basis: 26.1.2's codec() answered a KeyDispatchDataCodec of the MapCodec 26.2's codec() answers (MATERIAL_CONDITION held the MapCodec in both)
as ConditionSource.codec (MATERIAL_RULE held the MapCodec in both)
